$comment: Temporary, individually approved exceptions to the full-tree dependency audit. Read by scripts/audit-gate.ts, which fails CI when an entry expires, when its advisory stops being reported, or when a patched version is published. Production dependencies are never excepted: the CI step `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high` does not read this file. See docs/POLYTOS-AUDIT-EXCEPTION-PICOMATCH.md.

exceptions.removeWhen: A picomatch release above 4.0.7 is published, or the date in `expires` is reached, whichever is first.
